l-e-e5-b06-14.material: Teach → teacher (nama barsiisu), paint → painter (nama calaqu), sing → singer (nama faarsu). Seera argadhu, hiika writer, kan write -er dabalate, tilmaami.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s1.r.b: Meeshaa miti. Fakkeenyawwan keessatti -er nama gocha sana gochu jechuu dha.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s1.r.c: Barreeffama mataa isaa miti. Fakkeenyawwan keessatti -er nama gocha sana gochu jechuu dha.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s1.r.d: Iddoo miti. Fakkeenyawwan keessatti -er nama gocha sana gochu jechuu dha.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s1.explain: Gochima irratti -er yoo dabalamu, nama gocha sana gochu ta'a. Write → writer nama barreessu dha.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s2.model.0: Akka teacher, painter, fi singer, -er nama gocha sana gochu jechuu dha, kanaaf writer nama barreessu dha.
l-e-e5-b06-14.s.s2.model.1: Fakkeenyawwan sadanuu nama gocha sana gochu jechuu dha, kanaaf writer seera tokko hordofa.

l-e-e5-b06-15.title: Seera too fi either adda baasu
l-e-e5-b06-15.goal: Fakkeenyawwan baay'ee irraa seera too fi either, kanneen haala tokkuma fayyadu jedhan, argadhuu ibsi, achiis seera sana qabxii haaraan mirkaneessi.
l-e-e5-b06-15.material: I like pizza, and my friend likes pizza too. / I don't like fish, and my friend doesn't like fish either. Seera argadhu, duwwaa guuti: I can't swim, and my cousin can't swim ___
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Also dhuma hima ukkaamsaa irratti hin mijaa'u.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: Very jecha haala tokkuma fayyadu jedhu miti.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.c: Too hima mirkaneessaa keessatti fayyadama. Hima ukkaamsaa fakkeenyawwan keessa jiru keessatti either dha.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.explain: Dhuma hima mirkaneessaa irratti too, dhuma hima ukkaamsaa irratti either fayyadami. Can't jira, kanaaf either dha.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Fakkeenyawwan keessatti either dhuma hima ukkaamsaa irratti jira, kanaaf can't swim booda too osoo hin taane either fayyadami.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Himni ukkaamsaa either fudhata, himni mirkaneessaa too fudhata, kanaaf himni can't qabu either wajjin wal simu.
